title: Surfside Sauna

services.name: Social Sauna
services.desc: Surfside Sauna seats eight people and are perfect for adults looking for a quick, easy and relaxing wellness experience. Come solo to meditate and unwind, find a new community of sauna-loving friends or plan a creative date night. Social sessions are 60 minutes so you can complete multiple cycles of sauna heat and refreshing ocean plunges, with time to relax in between. Bathing suit or athletic attire - please wear upon arrival; however, there are public restrooms nearby. Two towels - one for sitting and one for drying. While we don’t have showers, we recommend using the ocean to rinse
